name: florida-home-search-uspr
description: Search Florida properties, view listing details, explore real estate guides and estimates, and request brokerage assistance.

interface.longDescription: Search Florida real estate in Aventura, Cape Coral, Fort Lauderdale, Fort Myers, Miami, Naples, Orlando and Tampa, or by ZIP code. View returned listing details, explore available real estate guides, and calculate mortgage and affordability estimates. With your consent, save contact information and favorite listings, request assistance from U.S. Prime Realty, and book, reschedule or cancel brokerage appointments. Guide downloads require contact information. Estimates are informational and are not loan approvals. Listing availability and accuracy depend on the connected data providers.
defaultPrompt: Find single-family homes in Cape Coral under $300,000.
Show me available real estate guides.
Estimate a mortgage for a $300,000 home with 20% down.

positive.description: Search single-family listings below $300,000 in Cape Coral. No contact setup required.
positive.prompt: Find single-family homes in Cape Coral under $300,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_properties with community Cape Coral, property_type sfr, maximumPrice 299999. Show only API-returned listings and the returned searchURL; report no matches honestly. Never require contact storage before search.

positive.description: Exercise the rental property type and bedroom filter.
positive.prompt: Find rentals in Miami with at least two bedrooms.
positive.expected_behavior: Use community Miami, property_type rnt and beds 2. Present actual returned rental listings and prices; do not present sale inventory as rentals.

positive.description: Multi-step detail lookup. Setup: search Cape Coral single-family homes below $300,000 and retain numbered results with actual id and brokerage.
positive.prompt: Show me more details about property number 1.
positive.expected_behavior: Call listing_details with the first returned listing's exact id and brokerage inside listings. Present returned details or an honest unavailable/error response. Never infer an MLS ID from the ordinal.

positive.description: Mortgage estimate using explicit user assumptions, without lender approval or a transaction.
positive.prompt: Estimate the monthly mortgage on a $300,000 home with $60,000 down, 6.5% annual interest and a 30-year loan.
positive.expected_behavior: Use price 300000, downPayment 60000, rate 6.5, years 30. Report the returned estimate as an estimate, identify included components from the response, and do not claim lender approval or invent taxes and insurance.

positive.description: Discover available guides without downloading or creating a CRM contact.
positive.prompt: What real estate guides are available?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_guides_list and show only guides actually returned. Do not call send_contact_info or download_guides without the user's subsequent request and consent.

negative.description: Out-of-scope geography. Explain supported Florida coverage and ask whether the user wants a supported Florida location. Do not call search_properties or substitute a Florida city.
negative.prompt: Find homes for sale in Austin, Texas.

negative.description: Loan approval is unsupported. Explain that calculators provide estimates and the brokerage is not a lender. Do not call any tool to approve credit, submit an application, or claim approval.
negative.prompt: Approve me for a mortgage and issue a loan commitment now.

negative.description: No personal email/calendar integration. Explain the limitation without sending messages, creating appointments, or claiming a calendar event was added. Do not call notify_agent or book_appointment as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Email my saved listings to my sister and add a showing to my personal Google Calendar.

publication.release_notes: Initial portable public-upload package connecting the existing U.S. Prime Realty MCP server. Includes listing metadata, existing brand asset, workflow instructions and draft review cases.
